SIGNALS.name: The Hacker News
SIGNALS.summary: Microsoft says a malicious extension version (2.1.313) never reached its VS Code Marketplace; Cursor rotated keys and rebuilt its marketplace. How attackers published under Anthropic's name is unclear.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: Cites the Financial Times: OpenAI has cut its funding target to about $20 billion from $30 billion, with a lower target valuation.

SIGNALS.name: *Walter Bloomberg
SIGNALS.summary: Nikkei is cited as reporting that Japan has asked Anthropic and OpenAI for more access to their advanced AI models.

SIGNALS.name: Layton Gott
SIGNALS.summary: Unconfirmed leaks suggest a GPT-6.2 release could come this weekend, citing a rumored internal model name and a new image model appearing in OpenAI API docs.

SIGNALS.name: Mistral AI
SIGNALS.summary: Mistral releases new weights for Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), saying it ranks first among open models on Cognition FrontierCode for agentic coding and cybersecurity.

SIGNALS.name: Megan
SIGNALS.summary: Summarizes Anthropic Claude for Legal: a gallery of ready-made artifacts such as contract review and cite checks, with custom documents, connectors and sharing.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI Developers
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI Developers says eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can now claim up to $500 per month in API credits to build apps and agents.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: Reports PsiQuantum unveiled an optical circuit switch initiative for AI data centers, with an 8x8 demo on its low-loss silicon photonics platform.

SIGNALS.name: Google DeepMind
SIGNALS.summary: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 4 Carbon as its next frontier model, state-of-the-art in cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities.
